title: Concept: Biometric template in a response
description: A biometric or fingerprint template field in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A biometric template cannot be reissued like a password, so a leak is permanent: it enables replay against any verifier that accepts the same template.
applicability: Deployments that render a biometric or fingerprint template field into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A biometric template cannot be reissued like a password, so a leak is permanent: it enables replay against any verifier that accepts the same template.
